title: The Real reason for the delay
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：real　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 real 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the keeper wrote of ① a real reason for the delay in the calendar, and everybody in the tower said at once that it was ② so real that nobody in the tower would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the real ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the real reason for the delay that anybody there had ever seen, or so the calendar for January 1970 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too real to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the real ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a real leather of the belt, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as real as the leather of the belt they had once had in the old tower. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was real or not, and he said so.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was ⑦ something real, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next tower called the whole plan ⑧ quite real; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the calendar kept the names of the real ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986, without complaint, she wrote of another real reason for the delay in the same calendar, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less real than anybody had expected. ⑩ The real leather of the belt that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1988, was the one she could never quite name; the real ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 真实（前置定语 a real reason for the delay：1976 年守夜人在年历里记下的那件真实的真正原因）
B. adj. 真实／真正（两处加强说法：so real that … 与 no less real than …）
C. adj. 真实／真正（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 真实（表语 too real to do：母亲觉得它太真实，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 真正（前置定语 a real leather of the belt：叔叔把整件事称作一桩真正的真皮）
F. adj. 真正（同级比较 as real as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩腰带的真皮相比）
G. adj. 真正（后置定语 something real：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 真正（受程度副词修饰 quite real：那位过路人的评价）

items.q: a real reason for the delay
the real reason for the delay that
a real leather of the belt
The real leather of the belt that

answers.why: real 意为“真实”，1976 年守夜人在年历里记下的是“一件真实的真正原因”，此处作前置定语 a real reason for the delay。
real 意为“真实”，此处用 so real that 结构，说它真实到钟楼里没人敢靠近。
real 意为“真实”，年历上 一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的真实拖延的真正原因，等于最高级的说法。
real 意为“真实”，母亲认为这件东西“太真实了，谁也用不上”，too real to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
real 意为“真正”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩真正的真皮”，此处作前置定语 a real leather of the belt。
real 意为“真正”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩腰带的真皮一样真正”，同级比较用 as real as。
real 意为“真正”，年历上那半行字要的是“真正的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something real。
real 意为“真正”，邻钟楼来的那位过路人认为这套计划“相当真正”，quite 修饰原级 real。
real 意为“真正”，no less real than 表示“其真正不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之真正不亚于任何人的预料。
real 意为“真正”，母亲 1988 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的真正真皮”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，守夜人在年历里记下了一件真实的真正原因。（a real reason for the delay）
它真实到钟楼里没有一个人敢靠近。（so real that …）
母亲觉得它太真实，谁也用不上。（too real to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩真正的真皮。（a real leather of the belt）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩腰带的真皮一样真正。（as real as …）
到了 1983 年，年历上只剩半行字：要的是一件真正的东西。（something real）
answers: In 1976 the keeper wrote of a real reason for the delay in the calendar.
It was so real that nobody in the tower would go near it.
My mother thought it too real to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a real leather of the belt.
He said nobody would call it as real as the leather of the belt they had once had.
By 1983 the calendar asked for nothing but something real.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 real 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the keeper wrote of a real reason for the delay in the calendar, and nobody forgot it.
It was the real reason for the delay that anybody there had ever seen, or so the calendar says.
My mother thought it too real to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a real leather of the belt, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next tower called the plan quite real, and everybody laughed.
The real ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
